notes.snake_bite_management: Published service scope for snake-bite case management; does NOT assert anti-snake venom is currently stocked.
notes.poisoning_management: Published service scope for poisoning/overdose management; does not imply toxicology lab or antidote stock.
notes.burns_care: Hospital states it treats burn patients; use burns_unit only when a dedicated burns unit is specifically documented.
notes.blood_storage_centre: A blood storage centre is not the same as a full blood bank; do not treat as blood_bank.
notes.location_verified: Coordinates from third-party map sources are approximate until checked against a map pin / hospital address.
notes.emergency_department: A hospital lists an emergency department/service, but the source reviewed does not clearly confirm 24/7 operation. Do not treat as emergency_24x7.
